pb.quote: Protea Banks lies 7.5 km offshore from Shelly Beach. … Depth ranges from 27–38m , dropping beyond 50m in places. Protea Banks attracts migratory sharks … a high-energy, advanced dive site ideal for experienced divers.

pb2.quote: Located in the powerful Agulhas Current, the reef is known for its deep water, strong currents and ever-changing ocean conditions … Most dives take place between 30 and 36 metres and are conducted as drift dives … divers should hold an Advanced Open Water certification (or equivalent) and have approximately 35 logged dives

access.value: Boat from Shelly Beach harbour; about 35 logged dives and Advanced Open Water expected

highlights.text: Hammerhead, bull, tiger and ragged-tooth sharks
Northern and Southern pinnacles with caves and drop-offs

hazards.text: Strong Agulhas Current; negative entry and blue-water ascent

summary.text: Offshore reef system about 7.5 km from Shelly Beach, made of two pinnacles, sand channels and drop-offs in the Agulhas Current. It is a deep, fast drift dive for experienced divers, known for hammerheads and other sharks.

sites.name: Komati Springs

bg.quote: Maximum depth found to date in the mine system is about 186 m, and 53 m in open water. … 5 to 40 m is reported. … The cave system of the old mine has 8 interconnecting levels with depths from 9 m to 186 m. … This is a high altitude inland shore dive site.

access.value: Cave certification required for overhead areas; no permit needed

sites.depthNote: Open water to 53 m; flooded mine cave system to about 186 m

cd.quote: 7 Mile Reef (Northern Wall and Mushroom Rocks) … nestled between depths of 15m at the summit and 24m at the base. … Depth: 16-22m Qualification Required: Advanced Open Water

am.quote: Seven Mile Reef Depth: 22-24m (ADV Dive) Often toted as the best dive site in Sodwana Bay … Mushroom Rocks … a favourite haunt of Ragged-tooth sharks and other large pelagic species

highlights.text: Black-tipped reef sharks and pelagic schools

summary.text: Sodwana's best-regarded advanced reef, with a drop-off from about 15 m at the summit to 24 m. Its high ledge, Mushroom Rocks bommies, reef sharks, big morays and turtles make for varied multi-level dives.

cd.quote: Gotham … a breathtaking ledge that plunges divers into a thrilling 40m adventure … dives are capped at 40m … Depth: 35-40m (on ledge) Qualification Required: Deep Speciality

am.quote: Gotham (named for the dark and eerie Gotham City in Batman) is the deepest of these and drops down to 40m towards the 5 Mile Canyon

hazards.text: Deep dive; narcosis risk at 35-40 m

summary.text: The deepest of the Five Mile Reef sites, a ledge dropping to about 40 m toward the 5 Mile Canyon. Deep-specialty certification is needed, and dives are capped at 40 m.

wvE.quote: Partridge Point Reef dive. Boat access only. Maximum depth 26 m. … Very large granite boulders and outcrops, some extending above the surface by several metres.

highlights.text: Very large granite boulders and outcrops

wg.quote: Maximum depth is about 58m. … About 6m above 20m, and about 15m below 20m. … Wondergat is a collapsed cavern filled with water. … Water temperature will be between 14 and 21°C … This is a shore entry site.

gw.quote: the roughly oval opening measures about 75m by 100m and reaches around 58m at its deepest point … Water temperatures generally range between 14°C and 21°C … The site is used by advanced, technical and instructor-level divers

access.value: Entry fee payable; steps down to the water; no permit needed

highlights.text: Collapsed dolomite sinkhole with side caverns

summary.text: Flooded dolomite sinkhole about 75 by 100 m across, with near-vertical walls and caverns off the bottom, to roughly 58 m. It is a freshwater shore dive mostly used by advanced and technical divers.
